instruction: ESD Protection Placement The file board.kicad_pcb has 4 external connectors (J1-J4) each protected by an ESD array (D1-D4). The ESD arrays are currently placed far from their connectors. The file esd_map.csv maps each connector pad to its ESD signal pad and net. Move each ESD array so its signal pin (as listed in esd_map.csv column esd_signal_pad) is within 5 mm of the corresponding connector pad. Do not change connector positions. Preserve the ESD footprint rotation. Requirements: 1. Each ESD signal pad is <= 5 mm from its connector pad (per esd_map.csv). 2. Connector footprint positions unchanged. 3. ESD footprint rotation preserved. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
source: TI / Analog Devices / Nordic / Microchip PCB layout app notes (TESD5V5U4LC TDK app note), IPC-A-610H Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies

command: import pyautogui; import time; RATIO_X = 0.589; RATIO_Y = 0.726; time.sleep(5); screen_w, screen_h = pyautogui.size(); x = int(screen_w * RATIO_X); y = int(screen_h * RATIO_Y); pyautogui.click(x, y); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click(x, y); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click(x, y)
